newsitem.title: UK: London gold edges lower post option expiry.
newsitem.headline: London gold edges lower post option expiry.

text.p: Gold prices probed the lower end of their recent range on Monday afternoon after over the counter (OTC) options expired with the market straddling the key $340 per once strike price.
"The OTC expiry has done absolutely nothing for the market," one dealer said but he cautioned that there was a "feeling of inevitability about gold moving lower."
Gold was fixed at $340.20 per ounce against $341.25 this morning and a dollar higher than that on Friday afternoon.
